message: 30 test(s) removed and not re-added elsewhere: should encode values with non-cookie-octet chars, should have backward compatible export, should include httpOnly flag when true, should include partitioned flag when true, should include secure flag when true …
reason: Commit 'Remove deprecated code paths' drops the 2/3-arg stringifySetCookie overload and the serialize/parse aliases from src/index.ts. In src/stringify-set-cookie.spec.ts most old tests were rewritten to the object API and folded into it.each tables or combined tests (e.g. httpOnly/secure/partitioned true -> 'should include enabled flags'; priority/sameSite/maxAge cases -> it.each; 'should encode values with non-cookie-octet chars' -> 'should URL-encode value'), so the count of 30 is inflated by renames/parametrization. Some tests are genuinely gone with no counterpart: 'should have backward compatible export' and 'should support three argument mode' (functionality removed), 'should not set when undefined' (maxAge), 'should not include partitioned flag when not defined', 'should not set sameSite when false' (false not in new sameSite it.each). Tests were removed, largely tied to removing deprecated API.
